name: Nico Magni
headline: Co-Founder @Cedalio (YC S23) - Tech Enthusiast - Digital Product Lover
about:
As a Co-Founder at Cedalio, we empower application builders to harness the advantages of decentralized technology while prioritizing user data ownership. Our mission is to be the database that tracks every application data change, and maintains an immutable and verifiable history record over time. By using us companies can store information about their most critical applications to reduce fraud and increment auditability and provide a fast recovery when needed. 

Additionally, as the Cofounder and Managing Partner at Wolox, a leading software creation and development agency that was later acquired by Accenture, I spearheaded Business Development efforts. My focus was on expanding the company's presence in Latin America and the United States, which included establishing new offices in Argentina, Chile, Colombia, and Mexico City.

I also assumed responsibility for overseeing the Strategy & Consulting team, where we played a pivotal role in crafting Go-to-Market strategies for our products and shaping digital solutions to achieve our business objectives.

Software Engineer from the Technology Institute of Buenos Aires (Instituto Tecnológico de Buenos Aires, ITBA) and MBA from IAE Business School. Member at Vistage: the world-leading organization in executive coaching and peer advisory.
